description: Update fields of a task. Proactively use this when priorities shift or new information comes in. Changing status directly is reserved for humans (actor human:*); agents move tasks with claim_task, submit_task, report_failure, escalate and release_task.

actor.description: Who is making the change, e.g. human:umit, or your own agent id with on_behalf_of. Required for status changes

addBlockedBy.description: Task IDs that block this task (appended to existing list)

blocked_by.description: Task IDs that block this task (replaces existing list)

criteria.description: Acceptance criteria this task is responsible for (replaces the list). Must belong to the task's spec

on_behalf_of.description: When a human explicitly asked you (an agent) to change status: their id, e.g. human:umit. Recorded with your agent id

status.description: New status (backlog, ready, claimed, blocked, needs_verification, verified, needs_human, done, cancelled). Requires a human actor

task_id.description: Task ID to update (hex ID or short ID like "zrdt-180")

verification.description: Verification commands keyed by kind (build, unit, integration, lint). Overrides project defaults per key

name: update_task
title: Update Task
